title: Woman Raking Yard, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from around the 1950s depicting a woman raking grass or leaves in a spacious suburban backyard. She wears a plaid button-down blouse and high-waisted shorts, reflecting post-WWII casual women's fashion. The outdoor setting includes a wooden perimeter fence, bare trees, and open lawn space.
